claims.claim: n8n is a workflow automation platform combining AI capabilities with business process automation, allowing both code and no-code workflow building.

excerpts.excerpt: n8n is a workflow automation platform that uniquely combines AI capabilities with business process automation, giving technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code.

claims.claim: n8n offers over 400 pre-configured integrations and an HTTP request node for custom connections.

excerpts.excerpt: We've built over 400 pre-configured integrations to help you achieve this.

claims.claim: n8n supports code fallback via JavaScript or Python nodes, and can add npm packages on self-hosted instances.

excerpts.excerpt: Use the code node to write custom transformations in JavaScript or Python. On self-hosted instances, add npm packages for even more power.

claims.claim: n8n can be self-hosted (Docker/K8s, air-gapped) or used via a cloud offering, with a free community edition.

excerpts.excerpt: Go fully on-premise with Docker or K8s in minutes. Run it air-gapped on your private network, or use our robust cloud solution. The community version is free, an enterprise license isn't.

claims.claim: n8n states it can handle up to 220 workflow executions per second on a single instance.

excerpts.excerpt: n8n handles up to 220 workflow executions per second on a single instance.

claims.claim: n8n claims SOC 2 audit compliance and regular external penetration testing.

excerpts.excerpt: We are SOC 2 audited and regularly perform external pen tests.

claims.claim: n8n describes itself as the world's most popular workflow automation platform for technical teams, citing GitHub stars, G2 rating, and community size.

excerpts.excerpt: Top 50 Github. Our 202.2k stars place us among the most popular projects.
4.7/5 stars on G2. To quote "I can move fast and never feel boxed in."
200k+ community members. This wouldn't be possible without you.

claims.caveat: These are company-published case study summaries with named individuals but no independent verification of the figures.
claims.claim: n8n's homepage cites case studies of Huel saving 1,000 hours of manual work and Vodafone saving £2.2 million using n8n.

excerpts.excerpt: How Huel built an AI first company culture and saved 1,000 hours of manual work
How n8n revolutionized threat intelligence at Vodafone and saved £2.2 Million

claims.claim: n8n's pricing includes tiered plans (Starter, Pro, Business, Enterprise) with differing execution limits, AI credits, and support levels, billed per full workflow execution rather than per step.

excerpts.excerpt: Unlike other tools that charge per step or user, n8n lets you build freely and only pay when a workflow runs from start to finish.
3 shared projects 20 concurrent executions 7 days of insights Up to 13,700 AI credits/month

claims.caveat: This is a third-party workflow template listed on n8n's site, not a claim about n8n's own product or team; traffic/monetization figures are unverified self-reported claims by the template creator.
